correctness.rationale: For every d>=1, H(d,3) graph with one qubit per vertex and pure unweighted CZ graph state, reduce every hyperplane normal u to s active coordinates by Hamming automorphisms; inactive coordinates give 3^{d-s} separate blocks. On each active hyperplane, rows of the cross-cut adjacency over F2 map to T_±f(z)=f(z)+sum f(z±e_j) on F3^{s-1}. Extending scalars to F4 diagonalizes translation, and λ_+(a)=λ_-(a)^2, so the common nullity is (3^{s-1}-(-1)^{s-1})/4 by elementary additive-character orthogonality. Rank equals 3^{d-s}(3^s+(-1)^{s-1})/4; pure graph-state reduced spectrum is flat with entropy rank. The normalized rank formula has strict max s=1 and min s=2 for d>=2. Independent binary rank calculations for all affine normals/offsets through d=4 matched. Infinite-dimensional claim follows character proof rather than finite samples.
